D: Eddie and Venom face the serial killer Cletus Kasady, who bonds with a symbiote called Carnage.
P: Serve the mains when Venom tries to cook Eddie breakfast.
S: Mrs Chen's sriracha mayo potato gems

Frozen potato gems baked at 220C for 20 minutes until crunchy, served with mayo mixed with sriracha and garlic. Spread 1kg frozen potato gems on 2 lined trays and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy. Mix 150g Japanese mayo with 2 tbsp sriracha, 1 small grated garlic clove and a squeeze of lime. Toss the hot gems with a pinch of salt, pile into bowls, drizzle with the sriracha mayo and scatter with sliced spring onion and toasted sesame seeds.

Dark and milk chocolate set thick around marshmallows, honeycomb, salted peanuts and raspberry lollies, smashed into chunks for a symbiote-sized craving. Line a 20cm square tin with baking paper. Melt 250g dark chocolate and 150g milk chocolate together in short bursts in the microwave. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roughly broken honeycomb, 100g salted peanuts and 80g raspberry lollies. Spread into the tin and chill for 2 hours until firm. Smash or cut into big rough chunks and pile into a bowl.
Venom's pet chickens, Sonny and Cher, who are not on the menu
Chicken thigh pieces dipped in egg and panko, baked at 220C for 15 minutes until golden, with honey mustard.
M: Venom trying to cook Eddie breakfast and wrecking the kitchen
Soft scrambled eggs, crisp bacon and buttered toast, with a square of dark chocolate on the side, because Venom insists.

Chicken thighs grilled with chipotle and lime, rolled in big flour tortillas with rice, black beans, cheese and salsa, toasted in a pan. Marinate 700g chicken thigh with 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, the juice of 1 lime, 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 30 minutes. Grill 5 minutes a side and slice. Cook 1 cup rice and stir in coriander and lime. Warm 1 drained tin black beans. Lay out 4 large flour tortillas and fill with rice, beans, chicken, 150g grated cheese, salsa and sour cream. Roll up tightly and toast seam side down in a dry pan for 2 minutes a side.
W: Red velvet sponge of buttermilk, cocoa and red colouring baked at 175C for 30 minutes, stacked and covered in cream cheese frosting.
K: Chocolate ice cream blended thick with cold milk and cocoa, poured into glasses streaked with fudge sauce and topped with crumbled brownie. Warm 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream, stirring until smooth, and cool slightly. Drizzle a spoon of the fudge sauce down the inside of 4 tall glasses. Blend 8 scoops chocolate ice cream with 500ml cold milk and 2 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into the glasses, drizzle with the rest of the sauce and crumble a small brownie over each. Serve with wide straws.

s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into chunks. Dip in beaten egg and press into panko breadcrumbs. Spread on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes until golden. Mix honey with Dijon mustard for a dipping sauce.

m.note: Venom trying to cook Eddie breakfast and wrecking the kitchen
m.how: Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble slowly in butter until soft. Toast and butter thick white bread. Pile it all onto plates and add a square of dark chocolate on the side, because the symbiote insists.

w.how: Whisk 300g flour, 2 tbsp cocoa, a teaspoon of bicarb, 300g sugar, 2 eggs, 250ml oil, 250ml buttermilk and red colouring until smooth. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cool and stack with cream cheese beaten with icing sugar, covering the whole cake.
